description: Suggests a 3- to 6‑month trial of testosterone dosing to achieve a mid‑normal premenopausal value in a reference assay for postmenopausal women with properly diagnosed HSDD and no contraindications. Triggered when a postmenopausal woman requests therapy for low sexual desire after appropriate HSDD workup and exclusion of contraindications.
